facts.text: The hotel sits alongside Hyde Park Corner and Wellington Arch.
facts.excerpt: Superbly situated alongside Hyde Park Corner and Wellington Arch, The Peninsula London

facts.text: The hotel is newly built and designed to harmonise with the surrounding heritage buildings.
facts.excerpt: Newly built and impeccably designed to harmonise with the surrounding heritage buildings

facts.text: Rooms and suites are designed by Peter Marino, combining contemporary British character with residential comfort.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Peter Marino, elegant rooms and suites combine contemporary British character with residential comfort

facts.text: Grand Premier Park Rooms have large picture windows overlooking Wellington Arch and the daily parade of the Household Cavalry.
facts.excerpt: Large picture windows offer guests spectacular views over Wellington Arch and the daily parade of the Household Cavalry (the Buckingham Palace mounted guards).

facts.text: The 6th-floor Peninsula Suite has a private terrace overlooking Hyde Park Corner.
facts.excerpt: the 6th-floor Peninsula Suite has a sweeping private terrace overlooking Hyde Park Corner

facts.text: The Peninsula Suite's living room has a fireplace and a baby grand piano.
facts.excerpt: a living room with a fireplace and baby grand piano

facts.text: Grand Premier Terrace Rooms have sliding glass doors opening onto private terraces.
facts.excerpt: With sliding glass doors that open onto private terraces, these rooms provide excellent vantage points

facts.text: Brooklands by Claude Bosi is a rooftop restaurant inspired by British motorsport.
facts.excerpt: Rooftop restaurant inspired by British motorsport

facts.text: Brooklands by Claude Bosi holds two Michelin stars.
facts.excerpt: From two-starred drinking and dining at Brooklands by Claude Bosi

facts.text: Brooklands Bar is a rooftop cocktail bar with views across the London skyline.
facts.excerpt: A sleek space showcasing innovative cocktails, as well as striking views across London’s skyline, Brooklands Bar makes an unforgettable day-to-night rooftop destination.

facts.text: On the way to the rooftop, guests pass a 1933 Napier Railton car and a Concorde nose before a lift styled like a hot-air balloon.
facts.excerpt: guests pass a 1933 Napier Railton car and Concorde nose on the way to a lift styled like a hot-air balloon

facts.text: Brooklands is named after the world's first banked race track.
facts.excerpt: named after the world’s first banked race track

facts.text: Canton Blue is designed by Henry Leung of Cap Atelier to reflect the contents of the 19th-century trading ship the Keying junk.
facts.excerpt: The Canton Blue restaurant is far more focused—a low-lit, lushly Oriental space designed by Cap Atelier’s Henry Leung to reflect the contents of the 19th-century trading ship, the Keying junk.

facts.text: The Lobby has hand-blown crystal chandeliers and de Gournay murals depicting scenes of nearby Hyde Park.
facts.excerpt: hand-blown crystal chandeliers and de Gournay murals depicting scenes of nearby Hyde Park

facts.text: The Lobby serves an all-day menu and is home to The Peninsula's signature Afternoon Tea.
facts.excerpt: The Lobby serves an all-day menu of international favourites and is home to The Peninsula's signature Afternoon Tea.

facts.text: The indoor pool sits in a subterranean chamber with mosaic artwork of tranquil landscape scenery.
facts.excerpt: occupies an expansive subterranean chamber, whose walls are adorned with intricately-crafted mosaic artwork depicting tranquil landscape scenery

facts.text: The pool's illuminated overhead light panels change through the day to simulate natural sunlight.
facts.excerpt: illuminated overhead light panels change through the course of the day to simulate natural sunlight

facts.text: The pool is heated and has underwater speakers so guests can listen to music as they swim.
facts.excerpt: The pool is heated and equipped with underwater speakers so guests can enjoy music as they swim

facts.text: The spa has separate steam and sauna rooms for men and women and a relaxation lounge with heated lounge chairs.
facts.excerpt: Separate steam and sauna rooms are available for men and women, along with a relaxation lounge featuring heated lounge chairs.

facts.text: The spa offers seven treatment rooms, including one couples treatment room.
facts.excerpt: All treatments are provided in the privacy of seven exclusive treatment rooms, including one couples treatment room.

facts.text: The spa has nine treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: With nine treatment rooms

facts.text: Hotel guests can have the salon's hair and nail services in their rooms on request.
facts.excerpt: Upon request, hotel guests can also comfortably enjoy these hair and nail services in their rooms.

facts.text: The hotel's fleet includes Rolls-Royce Phantom VIIs, a Bentley Bentayga and an electrified Austin Taxi.
facts.excerpt: From Rolls-Royce Phantom VIIs and a Bentley Bentayga to an electrified Austin Taxi, BMW i7 and LEVC

facts.text: From 1 to 31 October, guests can ride in six fleet vehicles transformed into an artwork by KOZO.
facts.excerpt: From 1 to 31 October, Peninsula guests can experience the artwork first-hand by travelling in one of the six transformed vehicles.

facts.text: There is no kids' club, but a Children's Program offers board games, treasure hunts and in-room treats.
facts.excerpt: There’s no kids’ club, but there is a Children’s Program with board games, treasure hunts, and in-room treats.

facts.text: Small domestic pets are allowed, with pet-sitting and pet-walking available.
facts.excerpt: Small domestic pets are allowed, with pet-sitting services and pet-walking available.

facts.text: The building is BREEAM-certified.
facts.excerpt: As a new-build, The Peninsula is BREEAM-certified

facts.text: There is a shopping arcade with nine boutiques, including Moussaieff and Asprey.
facts.excerpt: There’s a shopping arcade with nine boutiques, including high jewelers—Moussaieff and Asprey

facts.text: Hyde Park is a hop across the road, and Knightsbridge is a stroll to the west.
facts.excerpt: it’s a hop across the road to Hyde Park, or stroll west into Knightsbridge

facts.text: The hotel is 23.8 km (14.8 miles) from London Heathrow Airport.
facts.excerpt: Distance from London Heathrow Airport 23.8 km / 14.8 miles

facts.text: The hotel had its soft opening in September 2023.
facts.excerpt: Barely a week after its soft opening (back in September 2023)

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler included the hotel in its Hot List 2024.
facts.excerpt: Hot List 2024

facts.text: Bedside tablets and phone-style devices let guests read newspapers or contact reception via PenChat.
facts.excerpt: With tablets and phone-style devices next to beds (for reading newspapers or using the WeChat-style PenChat to contact reception)
